newsitem.title: HONG KONG: U.S.'s Summers says encouraged about U.S. economy.
newsitem.headline: U.S.'s Summers says encouraged about U.S. economy.

text.p: U.S. Deputy Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers said on Monday he was encouraged about the U.S. economy.
Summers said two features of the economic expansion had led him to this view -- the expansion had been investment-led, and it had been based on low inflation.
"This suggests that the expansion has some way to run," Summers told a business luncheon in Hong Kong.
Summers said the U.S. administration will continue to pursue policies geared toward the long-term health of the U.S. economy.
These include efforts to narrow the budget deficit, support the independence of the Federal Reserve, and promote free trade and growth of U.S. exports, he said.
